title: Windows 11 Notification
blurb: Softer and rounder than its ancestors, and considerably more apologetic, the Windows 11 alert belongs to an operating system that would very much like you to give Edge another chance. Microsoft's notification sounds trace a clear family line back to the nineties, and each generation gets a little politer as the interruptions get a little more frequent. This one is built to be noticed and then immediately forgiven. Play it for gentle interruptions, unwanted software suggestions, and that particular moment when a machine asks you to finish setting up your device for the ninth time.
